$comment: THE ESTATE'S GATE FIXTURE (scripts/fixture.mts) — who plays each role when the live gates run against the ap-home estate. Names only; no key, no grant. The people are the estate's six demo personas (demo/personas.estate.local.json, held by the Home). The organization, the second organization and the treasuries are chartered by scripts/provision-estate-fixtures.mts through the steward's own Ask with plans supplied and mandates signed at her Home — nothing is minted by a script key. A role the estate does not hold yet is null: the gates that need it say `⊘ skipped:` by name and the runner shows them waiting. specialist: a service the steward's playbook hands payments to (verify-handoff / verify-authority-chain) — chartered later; ministry: a content-catalog agent in the public registry (Ligonier is faithnet's) — none here; team + team2: volunteer-rota.team and volunteer-drivers.team under soup-kitchen.org — 'volunteer' names two of mara's agents and not the room, which the confirmation-memory gates need (a word the ROOM answers to is settled without a question). kitchen-crew.team (also under soup-kitchen.org) is the ROUTINE agent: it carries the coordinator playbook, whose schedule rows the routine gates pause — and which exposes no invite, so it must not be one of the two teams the ambiguous word names (an invite routed to it is refused unknown_tool).
